meta.name: scam-narrative-rewrite-queue
meta.purpose: Roll out NYC-style 3-beat narrative rewrites (Setup → Pivot → Mechanism + bolded defensive move) to all scam city pages with comics.
completion_criteria: TLDR is a complete trap-summary sentence (not a narrative opener)
Story body has 3-5 paragraphs following Beat 1 (Setup+Hook), Beat 2 (Pivot+Pressure), Beat 3 (Mechanism + Social Proof + bolded Defense Cue)
Each Beat 3 closes with one bolded defensive move
api/v1/scams/<slug>.json synced to match the rendered HTML

tiers.flagship: Lead city for each of the 13 country books (Tokyo for Japan, Rome for Italy, etc.) — highest revenue priority
tiers.book-secondary: Other cities in the 13 country-book countries
tiers.non-book: Cities in countries without a dedicated book — bundle CTA pages

meta.runner: Cron runner picks first status=pending entry by lowest priority, marks in-progress, executes the scam-page-builder skill (Step 4-12 only — research is unnecessary since the page already exists), then marks complete on PR-merge or failed on exception.

queue.notes: Reference implementation. Sets the pattern.
